selection.method: Farthest-profile selection over normalized structural and basic-method residual features, then individual coordinate-based editorial notes. Search nodes do not select the tier.

tierBasis: Provisional editorial grouping by residual constraint scope; search nodes are proof cost only.

binary: Retain balanced row patterns with no three equal neighbours, then reject a completed pattern already used by another row. Apply the same distinctness test to columns.

At a stall, compare the remaining patterns of intersecting rows and columns. A symbol should be committed only after its alternatives are ruled out by a visible rule; these notes do not provide a complete no-guess trace.
